dedupe_keys.name: ec3 embodied carbon in construction calculator and epd database

description: EC3, the Embodied Carbon in Construction Calculator, is a free, open-access tool from the non-profit Building Transparency, founded in 2020, together with its supporting database of digital, third-party verified environmental product declarations (EPDs), which it describes as the largest open-access database of its kind with global reach. Users set upfront embodied carbon baselines and targets for projects and search, filter and compare products, including facility and supply-chain specific EPDs, to specify and procure lower-carbon materials; tallyLCA, a whole-building LCA tool, sits alongside it. Other software such as Autodesk, Bentley, 2050 Materials and cove.tool use the EPD data via API, and Building Transparency with ERG has introduced open Product Transparency schemas for exchanging product environmental data. Coverage: EPDs from many countries. Access: web tool after free sign-up, and API under terms of service. Licence: free open access; API terms apply. Caveats: EPDs differ in scope and background data, so comparisons must respect product category rules. Simulation uses are embodied carbon inputs for building and infrastructure LCA and low-carbon procurement scenarios. Related records: ÖKOBAUDAT and the CLF WBLCA benchmark dataset.
